Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} (revenant family)

Patron Clan: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce}

Once merchant princes of the 12th-century Italian city-states, the Grimaldis are the most outwardly "normal" revenant family, retaining a sharp head for business and a taste for the comforts of great wealth. Children grow up groomed for corporate and political power, proving themselves outside the family's own holdings before taking a place within them. Under their own name and a dozen married-in lineages, Grimaldis sit on corporate boards, hold civic office, and serve throughout the Roman Catholic hierarchy on several continents, with no single geographic center to the family.

Role: The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s financiers, fixers, and face to mortal society — legitimate-seeming agents who manage money, influence, and institutional connections.

Behind the public face, family elders maintain a closely guarded contingency plan: convinced the family survives only at @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} sufferance, they quietly negotiate with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} and the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.z724BOvqpVyxjr6o]{Giovanni} about terms under which those clans might protect the family if Tzimisce patronage ever lapsed. Discovery of these talks would mean the family's destruction, so the negotiating elders stay deliberately distant from ordinary Sabbat contact, while encouraging younger Grimaldis to build ties with other Sabbat clans as cover and as a hedge.

Disciplines: Celerity, Dominate, Fortitude

Weakness: Every Grimaldi is blood bound to a Sabbat vampire of bishop rank or higher at puberty, a tradition meant to guarantee the family's loyalty given its extensive dealings in mortal society. The sect rarely invokes these bonds directly, but they remain a built-in leash.

Path: Traditionally Honorable Accord or Power and the Inner Voice, with a minority on the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.db3Fhvpv32rhN3Mm]{Path of Caine} (limited by their inability to commit diablerie). A growing modern faction has returned to Humanity, arguing that visible moral monstrosity is bad for business in an age of mass media — a trend the family's Tzimisce overseers regard with some alarm.
